clauses.rule: Expose reverse body, incoming shadow and individual screen ratio checks. Failure rejects only the selected descriptive profile. A match does not prove a Trex subtype or intrabar price path.
Keep pinbar, long-shadow and self-cover family checks separate. Do not require a reverse body or body fraction in the long-shadow screen.

ATR-relative wave and shape qualification needs a known strictly positive baseline. A zero or unavailable denominator is insufficient evidence, never a threshold of zero or automatic shape match. Ordinary legacy arithmetic also rejects zero baseline.

Report shape, wave, construction, timing, level kind and method confirmation independently. A counter bar lacking context is unresolved; a measured failed wave route or contradicted annotation is failed.

Method-confirmation gate always remains unresolved in this version. Require source-defined subtype, its confirmation rule and structural timeframe review before inferring a confirmation exemption. No automatic entry or order-node detection.

Withhold geometry when the own-timeframe closed event or contextual evidence is unavailable. Future prices and future annotations cannot pass a past gate. Preserve known obstacle time independently from later qualification reviews.

decisions.selected_profile_not_met: At least one evaluated condition fails; this is not a rejection of every Trex pivot or an opposite trade signal.
decisions.insufficient_evidence: No known failed gate, but required available data or a positive numerical baseline is absent.
decisions.needs_context_review: Local data is evaluable, but supplied wave or level-role context is unresolved.
decisions.needs_method_confirmation: All implemented local prerequisites pass; subtype/confirmation and structural context still need method evidence.

compatibility.shape_checks: ATR-dependent checks may now be null when not computable; do not coerce null to false or true.
compatibility.legacy_status: needs_exception_review remains unchanged for exceptional candidates
compatibility.ordinary_zero_atr: Rejected even when legacy arithmetic would previously have accepted positive distance against zero.
